tracks.title: Living In The Heart Of The Beast
Beautiful As The Moon- Terrible As An Army With Banners

verdict.detail: Discogs lists 2 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Recorded at the Manor, February - March 1975, except A1, recorded Nov. 1974.

Artist on cover : Henry Cow
Artists on spine and center label : Henry Cow + Slapp Happy

Labels:
Published by Virgin Music (Publishers) Ltd, except A. Moore, Blackhill Music Ltd
℗ 1975 Virgin Records Ltd

Tracks are numbered sequentially I-V on rear cover, as above on labels.

Runouts are stamped. Some of the characters are rotated 90 degrees to the right (e.g., the final letter in many variants.) 

Vinyl manufacturing company derived from runouts.
